Subject: Clarification regarding visitor arrangements

Dear [Sender's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to seek clarification on the email regarding the upcoming visitors. To ensure we provide the best possible experience for them, could you please provide more specific details regarding their dietary preferences? Additionally, please let me know if there are any other specific arrangements or requirements needed for their stay.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
